disruption_scenarios.name: Track Unavailable Disruption

disruption_event.description: Rail surface defect closes UP-1 between KM 31.8 and 32.2 from 01:00 to 04:00.

disruption_scenarios.expected_action: Reschedule non-committed UP-1 blocks to the next valid possession; committed blocks remain locked.

disruption_scenarios.name: Emergency Work Insertion

disruption_event.description: USFD detects a critical transverse rail crack at KM 14.2 requiring immediate repair.

disruption_scenarios.expected_action: Insert BLK-EMG-001 and pre-empt lower-priority non-committed work.

disruption_scenarios.name: Possession Window Curtailment

disruption_event.description: Late-running premium service delays the start of the UP-1 midday possession; effective window becomes 750-870.

disruption_scenarios.expected_action: Re-evaluate blocks against the remaining 120-minute window; move any block that no longer fits.

disruption_scenarios.name: Asset Condition Deterioration

disruption_event.description: Point motor temperature alarm escalates the asset from moderate risk to critical.

disruption_scenarios.expected_action: Re-score affected job and promote it into the active schedule.

disruption_scenarios.name: Infeasible Schedule

disruption_event.description: All DOWN-1 possession windows are cancelled while two committed blocks are locked.

disruption_scenarios.expected_action: Return structured INFEASIBLE status with the hard-lock/possession conflict reason.

disruption_scenarios.name: Asset Breakdown / OHE Failure

disruption_event.description: OHE contact wire failure causes a protection block and creates an emergency repair requirement.

disruption_scenarios.expected_action: Protect the affected track, insert emergency repair, and re-optimize remaining non-committed jobs.
